content.thinking: Format bug: `'icmp,d%d,...' % (lid, probe, addr, addr)` — the first %d should be a counter. Let me fix by using an index.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('/tmp/seccomp_nx.py'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("    rows.append('icmp,d%d,0,1,put,%s,1,%s,%s,%s,echo,,,' % (lid, probe, addr, addr))",
            "    rows.append('icmp,d%d,0,1,put,%s,1,%s,%s,%s,echo,,,' % (i, lid, probe, addr, addr))")
p.write_text(s)
PY
timeout 900 python3 /tmp/seccomp_nx.py
